notes: Limuru Tea Company Plc — micro-cap Kenyan tea estate listed on NSE. Owns ~600 ha (~1.5k acres) of tea bushes in Limuru, Kiambu County, plus a smaller block of forest land. Managed by Unilever Tea Kenya / Ekaterra under a long-standing management agreement. Calendar fiscal year. KES reporting; figures in KES millions. Highly thinly traded (only 2.4M shares outstanding). Profitability tracks Mombasa tea auction prices closely. Land book reflects historical cost; market value is estimated to be materially higher given Limuru's peri-urban location near Nairobi. Despite small size, full FY history maintained for cross-period comparability. FY2023-2024 hit by tea price weakness same as Sasini.

periods.notes: FY21: tea auction prices recovered, output up
FY22: best year of cycle, KES weakness boosted USD-priced tea exports
FY23: tea auction prices softened, gross margin compression
FY24: tea price weakness persisted; net cash maintained
